# Cascade FX palette mapping: old_index new_index
# Texture atlas colors are mapped below 128 for signed-byte fast loops. Distinct texture colors: 87.
# PC-FX SUP palette bank 12 (192..207) is preserved in generated palettes; texture colors in that range are duplicated into low indices.
# Some rare non-texture colors may share nearest palette entries to keep the fixed debug-text bank and low texture bank.
